module.purpose: Provides the settings-page layout for organization members, combining the shared settings shell with a localized organization-members header and nested page content.
module.summary: This module is an asynchronous application-router layout. It resolves the translation function, renders the shared settings layout with a wide container, and places a localized header around descendant member-management content while applying the shared call-to-action styling.
module.businessContext: Supports organization administrators managing members in the settings area. Failure would prevent the members page from rendering its navigation shell, localized context, and descendant content.
functions: Layout (~L7-19): Builds the organization members settings shell with localized header content.

detail.signature: export default async function Layout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode })
preconditions: The children argument is provided and is a valid React.ReactNode.
The translation service is available and can resolve the requested translation keys.
postconditions: Resolves organization member and organization description translations before producing the layout.
Returns a settings application layout containing a settings header with the supplied children.
Applies the configured container and call-to-action class names to their respective layout components.
invariants: The supplied children are rendered inside the settings header.
The layout uses the organization_members translation for the header title.
The layout uses the organization_description translation for the header description.
edgeCases: If children is an empty or nullish React renderable value, the layout still renders its surrounding settings layout and header.
If translation resolution fails, the asynchronous function does not produce the layout and the translation failure propagates to the caller.
